body: QIAGEN N.V. / Key word(s): Mergers and Acquisitions / Sale of Business Units/Results / QuarterQIAGEN N.V.: Conclusion of a Business Combination Agreement with EQT Private Equity; preliminary Q3 2026 results and suspension of full-year 2026 outlook21-Oct-2026 / 23:32 CET/CESTDisclosure of an inside information acc. to Article 17 MAR of the Regulation (EU) No 596/2014, transmitted by EQS News - a service of EQS Group.The issuer is solely responsible for the content of this announcement.Ad hoc Announcement according to Art. 17 Market Abuse RegulationConclusion of a Business Combination Agreement withEQT Private Equity; preliminary Q3 2026 results and suspension of full-year 2026 outlookVenlo, the Netherlands, October 21, 2026 – QIAGEN N.V. (NYSE: QGEN; Frankfurt Prime Standard: QIA) today entered into a Business Combination Agreement with Crown NL Bidco B.V. (the “Bidder”). Based thereon, the Bidder announced its intention to make a voluntary public tender offer to all QIAGEN shareholders for EUR 46.50 per QIAGEN share in cash.The Bidder is a holding company which is indirectly controlled by the EQT XI fund (“EQT Private Equity”) with further indirect participations held by co-investors Luxinva S.A. (a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA)), and CPP Investment Board Europe Inc. (a wholly-owned subsidiary of Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments)). EQT Private Equity is managed and controlled by affiliates of EQT AB with registered seat in Stockholm, Sweden.The transaction will be implemented through a public tender offer by the Bidder for all issued ordinary shares of QIAGEN for a cash consideration of EUR 46.50 per QIAGEN share (the “Takeover Offer”). The transaction values QIAGEN at approximately EUR 10.8 billion in enterprise value (approximately USD 12.1 billion at current exchange rates, including approximately USD 1.1 billion of net debt). The Takeover Offer represents a premium of 40.3% to QIAGEN's unaffected share price as of 8 July 2026, the last trading day prior to the publication of market reports regarding takeover interest from private equity firms, as well as a premium of 46.9% to the three-month volume-weighted average price (VWAP) on XETRA of EUR 31.66 per QIAGEN share up to and including 8 July 2026.The transaction follows a comprehensive review by QIAGEN’s Supervisory Board and Managing Board that assessed QIAGEN’s strategic prospects and included discussions with both strategic and financial parties. The Boards believe the transaction will provide the best environment for QIAGEN’s next growth phase, giving QIAGEN greater flexibility to invest for the long term under private ownership while providing shareholders with attractive immediate cash value. QIAGEN will continue to operate under the QIAGEN name and brand. As part of the Business Combination Agreement, EQT Private Equity has agreed to support QIAGEN's long-term development, including commitments relating to QIAGEN's business, key brands, operational footprint, R&D activities, employee arrangements, prudent financing and culture of excellence.QIAGEN’s Supervisory Board and Managing Board (“QIAGEN Boards”) unanimously approved the Business Combination Agreement and support the transaction. Under the terms and subject to the conditions of the Business Combination Agreement, the Boards will recommend that QIAGEN shareholders tender their shares into the Takeover Offer and vote in favor of the resolutions to be proposed at an Extraordinary General Meeting during the initial acceptance period (the “EGM”). Their formal recommendation will be published in a position statement after the Bidder publishes the offer document following clearance by the German Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht, “Bafin”) and the filing of the relevant U.S. tender offer materials. This recommendation remains subject to the terms of the Business Combination Agreement, review of the final offer document and the Boards' continuing fiduciary duties under applicable law.The Takeover Offer will be subject to a minimum acceptance threshold of 50% of QIAGEN’s outstanding share capital plus one share, the adoption of certain resolutions at the EGM, including approval of certain corporate measures to be implemented after closing of the Takeover Offer that will enable the Bidder to acquire full ownership of the entire business of QIAGEN (the “Post-Closing Measures”) , the adoption of a separate decision by the QIAGEN Boards to implement the Post-Closing Measures (the “Implementation Decision”), merger control and foreign investment clearances, and certain further conditions, which will be set forth in the offer document relating to the Takeover Offer.The implementation of the Post-Closing Measures will result in the Bidder acquiring full ownership of the entire business of the Company, and all shareholders of QIAGEN who have not accepted the Takeover Offer receiving a cash distribution in an amount per share equal to the Offer Price less applicable withholding taxes, which may result in a lower net amount being received than if such shareholders had accepted the Takeover Offer. In connection with the implementation of the Post-Closing Measures, the listings of QIAGEN shares on the FSE and the NYSE will be terminated.Under the Business Combination Agreement, the QIAGEN Boards will take the Implementation Decision if the Post-Closing Measures have been approved at the EGM by at least 80% of the votes cast. Otherwise, the QIAGEN Boards may still take the Implementation Decision if they determine, in accordance with their fiduciary duties, that proceeding with the transaction, including the Post-Closing Measures, is in the best interest of QIAGEN, taking into account the interests of its shareholders and other stakeholders and subject to the support of a substantial majority of its shareholder base.In determining whether the transaction has the support of a substantial majority of its shareholder base and whether the voting results provide a balanced reflection of the underlying shareholder support, the QIAGEN Boards may consider, amongst other things, the percentage of votes cast in favor of the Post-Closing Measures, attendance at the EGM, as well as the number of votes cast in favor of the Post-Closing Measures by longer-term shareholders compared to those who acquired shares subsequent to the announcement with the aim of frustrating the transaction or pursuing event-driven hedge fund strategies.Closing of the Takeover Offer is currently expected for mid-2027. If closing has not occurred within ten months of the date of this announcement because required regulatory approvals remain pending, QIAGEN may elect under the Business Combination Agreement to pay shareholders an interim dividend of up to USD 0.47 per share. Any such interim dividend would not be deducted from the offer price.QIAGEN Q3 2026 preliminary results and FY 2026 outlookQIAGEN today has announced preliminary third-quarter 2026 financial results. Net sales were USD 548 million at both reported and constant exchange rates (CER). Adjusted diluted earnings per share (EPS) were USD 0.65, also USD 0.65 CER.Given the announced transaction with EQT Private Equity, QIAGEN has suspended its full-year 2026 outlook while the transaction is pending.QIAGEN N.V.Hulsterweg 825912 PL VenloThe NetherlandsAd hocISIN: NL0015001WM6Frankfurt Stock Exchange, Regulated Market (Prime Standard)Contacts QIAGEN N.V.Corporate CommunicationsJohn Gilardi, Tel: +49 2103 29 11711; pr@qiagen.comImportant NoticeForward-looking StatementsCertain statements contained in this communication may be considered forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the U.S. Securities Act of 1933, as amended (“Securities Act”), and Section 21E of the U.S. Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended.
